description: [stores] Full-text search over YOUR memory values using FTS5. Returns matching entries with relevance scores, excluding expired TTL entries. Scoped to memory you own — registered handle + secret required. Omit namespace to search all of your own memory.

namespace.description: namespace to search within (omit to search all of yours)

query.description: FTS5 search terms (porter stemmer, unicode61 tokenizer)

name: search_memory
